pages.text: Consciousness below $(cfg)30$() — you fall. $(l)Fainting$() passes by itself; $(l)knockdown$() happens when life is threatened: a $(cfg)3–5$() min timer runs, then clinical death.

Lying down you see the sky, can only say "...", and can call for help from the menu ($(l)P$()). Others see you lying, can drag and search you.$(br2)The timer runs slower when you are in better shape (a transfusion buys time).
The stabilization kit: the knockdown timer runs at half speed ($(cfg)5$() min), once per knockdown.
